MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Ghost Rider Character Gameplay Guide
Robbie Reyes unleashes the Spirit of Vengeance! 

Our latest Character Guide breaks down Ghost Rider's devastating toolkit, from long-range chain and scythe attacks to blazing hellfire that keeps opponents under constant pressure.

Learn how to use the Hellcharger to rip through every fight, master the Vengeance Gauge to boost your skills and dominate from a distance before the flames consume you. 

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
